assets.name: identity-orbits-light.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: 16:9 Universal Profiles presentation background
Primary request: Create a new light-mode abstract background variation built around elegant concentric identity orbits and one softly glowing portal ring.
Style/medium: premium modern 3D editorial abstraction, restrained and spatial, consistent with the supplied Universal Profiles references.
Composition/framing: wide landscape; visual cluster anchored on the right third; keep the entire left 52 percent quiet and low-contrast for slide titles and body copy; subtle depth toward the edges.
Lighting/mood: soft luminous studio atmosphere, optimistic, intelligent, calm.
Color palette: white, cool mist, pale periwinkle, #A4B5FF, #8494EE, tiny cool slate accents; no dominant pink.
Materials/textures: translucent glass, frosted acrylic, soft volumetric haze, extremely subtle fine grain.
Constraints: background only; no words, no letters, no logos, no UI screenshots, no people, no devices, no watermarks; preserve large usable negative space; 16:9 landscape.
